question: As per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2023, which of the following UTs has the lowest poverty rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puducherry**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Puducherry** has the lowest poverty rate among the Union Territories as per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2023.
 
• The report assesses poverty based on various dimensions including health, education, and standard of living.
 
• Puducherry's effective policies and social welfare schemes
